                EMBLEM AND MOTTO
                      OF
                 BIKALI COLLEGE




The ‘emblem’ of Bikali College is embossed with an image
of a blossoming lotus on a mound of clay. The pot is placed
within a triangular frame. The name of the college is
inscribed within another triangular frame which surrounds
the previous frame. The year of establishment of the
college is inscribed in a hexagonal frame placed below the
triangles. The blossoming lotus symbolizes the flourishing
and dissemination of knowledge from the institution and
the clay underneath symbolizes the student community
who aspire to acquire new knowledge and wisdom.

                            BACKGROUND OF THE
                                COLLEGE

Bikali College is the seat of higher learning in the easternmost border of Goalpara district. The College was
established on 14th April, 1982. It is the outcome of selfless and dedicated service of the rural masses of fifty
four villages, which constitutes “Bikali Mouza Unnayan Samiti” – a socio- cultural Non- Governmental
Organization.


   NOMENCLATURE OF THE COLLEGE

The College is named after “Bikali Mouza” or “Dihi”, which is part of the historical “HabraghatPargana”.

  LOCATION


The College is located at Dhupdhara, a small township of Bikali Mouza area. It is 0.75 km. away from N.H.
17 and DhupdharaRailway Station. The College is under Rangjuli Tribal Development Block, Rangjuli
revenue circle and 36- Dudhnoi ST Reserved L.A.C. (constituency) in Goalpara district of Assam. The college
is 63.5 km distance from Gopinath Lokpriya Bordoloi Airport, Guwahati and 2.1 km from Dhupdhara Railway
Station.

   COLLEGE CAMPUS


The college has a sprawling green campus that extends and sprawls out in consonance with the rural
environment. Most of the buildings have been modelled and constructed keeping in view the future
landscape and also to harmonize well with the rural setting in the sylvan grandeur. At present, the college
built-up area is 32953 sq.mtrs.

   STREAM


The institution offers Arts, Commerce and Science courses at the Higher Secondary Level. Major/Minor is
offered in all the subjects at Under Graduate level. P.G. course in Assamese and Geography is also offered
along with career oriented programmes.

 AFFILIATION AND DEFICIT

The College has been affiliated to Gauhati University since the 1988-89 session. The College was brought
under Deficit –Grants –in Aid System in 1992 and presently under provincialised system of Govt. of Assam

                                                       6
 (2005). The college has been registered under UGC 12 (B) according to the 10th plan.



  NAAC      RE-ACCREDITATION


 The College has been re-accredited (Fourth cycle) by NAAC in 2024-25 and was awarded B+(2.7/4)
 grade.

    A Brief History about Bikali College


Bikali College is one of the premier institutions of higher education in
Assam. It is located at Dhupdhara, a small town on the National Highway
37 (New NH17) in the eastern most part of Goalpara district of Assam.
Bikali College was established on 14thApril, 1982 owing to their relentless
efforts and the missionary zeal of the 52 villages of the Bikali Mouza
towards providing quality higher education to the local students. The
Bikali   Mouza    Unnayan     Samittee,   a  philanthropic   socio-economic
organization of Bikali Mouza was instrumental in nurturing and shaping
the institution. Bikali College is a testimony to the far sightedness of its
founding members and their indefatigable zeal to actualize their dream.
From a makeshift wood and bamboo structure with only few students in
Pre-University classes in Arts stream, the college has come a long way to
where it stands today with a sprawling campus well equipped with modern
amenities.

The college is currently affiliated to Gauhati University and is presently
offering under graduate courses and along with post graduate courses in
Assamese and Geography. The Arts stream of the college was brought
under Deficit Grants-in-Aid schemes of government of Assam in 1992 and
it was subsequently provincialized in the year 2005 . In the course of its
growth and development, the Commerce stream and Science stream were
introduced in the college as self-financed course in the year 2005 and 2015,
respectively. In addition to these courses, the college also offers certificate
courses to students in all the three streams. The college received UGC
recognition of 2 (f) and 12(B) with effect from the10thPlan of the UGC.
The college has a sprawling campus spread over an area of more than 50
acres equipped with modern facilities for teaching and learning. The
college has, over the years built an impressive infrastructure and is trying
hard to create a student-friendly environment in the campus. ICT enabled
classrooms, well-equipped computer laboratory ,science laboratories,
central library with internet facility, digital library, seminar and
conference hall etc. are some of the teaching- learning facilities in the
college through which students are exposed to better learning experiences
in the campus.To nurture the hidden talents of students in co-curricular
and extracurricular activities, the college has indoor and outdoor stadium,
various literary and academic societies, NCC, NSS unit etc. Presently, the
NCC unit of the college has 100 cadets and another 21 cadets will be
enrolled in this academic session (2025-2026).
The institution is committed to pursuing its prime objectives of providing
                                         9
 quality and inclusive education on the basis of the values that form the
core of the college. The college is committed to breaking barriers brought
about by its remoteness and aspires to emerge at par with top educational
institutions utilizing local knowledge and expertise combined with global
skills and innovation. Based on our experiences and achievements, we
firmly belief that we will be definitely able to march ahead on our journey
to achieve the academic excellence that the founders of the college had
dreamt of.

   Courses Offered

The College offers courses in Arts, Commerce & Science at Higher Secondary (+2), Four Year
Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) and Three Years Degree Course (CBCS) in Arts, Science and
Commerce stream. The Undergraduate Course for all streams will be imparted as per Gauhati University
Regulation of Semester System. The college also offers PG course in Assamese and Geography.

          INCENTIVES, FACILITIES AND WELFARE ACTIVITIES

   INCENTIVES FOR MERITORIOUS AND NEEDY STUDENTS:

    Packages of incentives for meritorious as well as needy students have been offered by the college
    authority since many years. Five meritorious students securing more than 80% will be selected on
    the basis of the conditions laid down by the authority.

 FACILITIES AVAILABLE:

   Classrooms: Teaching-learning resources and contemporary amenities are well-equipped in the
    classrooms. All classrooms with digital learning and ICT-based facilities have whiteboard and green
    board with microphone , smart board, LCD projector etc. Geography, Education and the Science
    stream all feature fully functional laboratories fitted with state-of-the-art equipment. By using the
    allocated room numbers, students can locate their classroom with ease.


   Conference Halls: The College has a round table conference room and a conference hall with
    200 seating capacities designed with beautiful infrastructure, fully air-conditioned with LCD
    projection and purified drinking water facility.


   Auditoriums : The college has three large Auditoriums which is utilized as classrooms and
    functions as and when required.


   Sports Complex: Football playground, Volleyball court, Cricket ground and Badminton court
    and other practice ground for archery are also available. Besides, the College also has a mini
    stadium that facilitates various games programmes such as Relay Race, Marathon, Running race etc.
    during college week. In addition to sports facilities, indoor stadium is also used for fitness and
    training facilities such as gyms, weightlifting, Wushu and exercise areas. These facilities provide
    opportunities for students, faculty members, and staff to engage in different games and sports.


 Indoor Stadium: Bikali College has an Indoor Stadium for the students to practice Badminton,
    Table-Tennis , Chess, Wushu and Yoga. The Stadium has versatile sports facility that provides a
    covered space for various indoor sports and recreational activities. It is typically equipped with
    sports facilities, equipment, and amenities to promote physical activity, fitness, and sportsmanship
    among students, faculty members, and staff. In addition to sports facilities, indoor stadiums also
    include fitness and training facilities such as gyms, weight and exercise areas.

                                                       19
  Gymnasium : The college has a fully equipped Gymnasium Hall approved only for college
    students and Alumni. An in-house multifaceted indoor gymnasium is set up in the college premises
    to cater to the students' physical fitness. It has been fully operational since 2013. The indoor
    gymnasium has cutting-edge equipment and machines, including a Power Rack, Stationary Bike,
    and Treadmill, to name a few. It has gained enormous popularity among the entire college
    community since its inception. Students must register themselves with a minimal one-time
    registration fee to enroll themselves. Users may avail the facility under the proper care and guide of
    physical instructor. Cycling, Weightlifting, Shoulder machine, Tread Mill, barbells, Dumbbell, Yoga
    Mats, Mirror, Weight Machine and First Aid is available.


   Library :

    The college has well equipped Central Library, Digital Library and Departmental Libraries.


A. Central Library: The College library is placed in a calm and quiet environment with moderately
    high collection of text books, reference books of all subjects along with journals and newspapers for
    regular use of the teachers and students. The library has a well-furnished reading rooms, equipped
    with reading stands for students The students are allowed to go through books, journals,
    newspapers, and bulletins in the reading room during college hours. Two books are issued for
    General/ Minor course students and three books for Major course students are issued for a specific
    time. The borrower of the book will be responsible for any damage or loss of the book. Needy
    students are also issued books under ‘Book Bank Scheme’. Besides, reading facilities especially for
    Competitive Examination is also available in the library. The College library has been computerized
    for smooth management and systematic functioning. Apart from these, a distinctive cell on local
    publication is also available.


B. Membership: The Library membership is open to students, faculty members & office staff. The
    duration of membership will be for an academic year and will have to be renewed annually.
